name: Voodoo Dues
summary: In Booty Bay, “Sea Wolf” MacKinley is still waiting for three old debts to be paid. Maury “Club Foot” Wilkins, Jon-Jon the Crow, and Chucky “Ten Thumbs” owe him, but rumors say curses and enchantment sent them wandering ancient jungle ruins. MacKinley wants their prized possessions, whatever their fate.

sections.title: Unpaid Accounts
sections.body: You have already collected debts for “Sea Wolf” MacKinley, but three accounts remain unpaid. Maury “Club Foot” Wilkins, Jon-Jon the Crow, and Chucky “Ten Thumbs” have owed him for months. MacKinley first thought they had left Booty Bay to escape their debts. Then he heard they had met a stranger, darker fate deep in the jungle.

sections.title: Bewitched in the Ruins
sections.body: Whispers say curses and enchantment have left the three men wandering ancient stonework northeast of Booty Bay. They are said to roam the Ruins of Aboraz and the Ruins of Jubuwal. MacKinley wants you to find each man and take his notable valuables: Jon-Jon's Golden Spyglass, Chucky's Huge Ring, and Maury's Clubbed Foot.

faq.q: Who is asking to collect these debts?
faq.answer: “Sea Wolf” MacKinley asks you to collect the debts from his post in Booty Bay. He is working through his list of debtors and will not let their debts slip away.
The three debtors are Maury “Club Foot” Wilkins, Jon-Jon the Crow, and Chucky “Ten Thumbs”. They have owed their payments for several months.

faq.q: Where can the three debtors be found?
faq.answer: The three men wander ancient stone structures northeast of Booty Bay, in the Ruins of Aboraz and the Ruins of Jubuwal.

faq.q: What happened to the three men?
faq.answer: Word reaching MacKinley says the men were bewitched and cursed. They now roam the jungle ruins instead of returning to port.

faq.q: What specific items must be recovered?
faq.answer: MacKinley wants Jon-Jon's Golden Spyglass, Chucky's Huge Ring, and Maury's Clubbed Foot.

faq.q: What came before this task in the chain?
faq.answer: This follows your earlier work in Scaring Shaky and Return to MacKinley, helping the pirate collect his debts.
